title: Return Reason and Bonus Event Points on a Finch Circle Return
content:
**Schedule.** When Finch Circle Loyalty Program points are taken back on a refunded return, the return event share is none (0) when the return reason is defective, damaged in transit or not as described, one half (0.5) when it is wrong size or fit or an unwanted gift, and the whole (1) otherwise.

The return reason is the one recorded on the return request for the returned unit's purchase record under Merchandise Purchases.

| Return reason on the return request | Return event share |
|---|---|
| Defective | 0 |
| Damaged in transit | 0 |
| Not as described | 0 |
| Wrong size or fit | 0.5 |
| Unwanted gift | 0.5 |
| Any other reason recorded | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A blender returned as defective: share 0.
- Shoes returned for wrong size or fit: share one half.
- A handbag returned for a reason not listed above: share the whole.
